# Session Summary - 2025-10-20

## Issues Resolved ✅

### 1. BeatPlayer Visualization Colors
**Problem:** Visualizer používal cyan/purple barvy místo Music section rose/pink palety  
**Solution:** Změna canvas gradient v BeatPlayer.tsx:
- Shadow: `rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.5)` (rose-500)
- Gradient: `rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.95)` → `rgba(236, 72, 153, 0.95)` → `rgba(219, 39, 119, 0.95)`
- Rose-500 (#F43F5E) → Pink-500 (#EC4899) → Pink-600 (#DB2777)

**Files Changed:**
- `src/components/BeatPlayer.tsx` (lines 363-371)

### 2. React Hydration Error
**Problem:** Layout.tsx line 107 - server HTML `<html lang="cs">` vs client `<html lang="cs" data-theme="light">`  
**Root Cause:** Client-side script přidává `data-theme` attribute, ale server-rendered HTML ho nemá  
**Solution:** Přidán `data-theme="light"` a `className=""` do <html> tagu v layout.tsx

**Error Message:**
```
A tree hydrated but some attributes of the server rendered HTML 
didn't match the client properties.
- data-theme="light" (missing on server)
```

**Files Changed:**
- `src/app/layout.tsx` (line 107)

**Before:**
```tsx
<html lang="cs">
```

**After:**
```tsx
<html lang="cs" data-theme="light" className="">
```
